description: This file contains extension methods for the RequestContext class in Orleans, providing functionality to import and export context data and retrieve reentrancy IDs from messages or context data.

classes.name: RequestContextExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for working with RequestContext, including importing/exporting context data and retrieving reentrancy IDs.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Imports provided context data into the current RequestContext, replacing existing values.

methods.name: Export
methods.description: Exports a copy of the current RequestContext's context data using a DeepCopier.

methods.name: GetReentrancyId (Message)
methods.description: Retrieves the reentrancy ID from a Message's RequestContextData.

methods.name: GetReentrancyId (Dictionary<string, object>?)
methods.description: Retrieves the reentrancy ID from context data dictionary if present.
